metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.7 · 2003 · Daddy Day Care
metas.description: Two men named Charlie Hinton and Phil Ryerson get laid off and have to become stay-at-home fathers when they can't find jobs. This inspires them to open their own day care center.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 3.3 · 2007 · Daddy Day Camp
metas.description: Seeking to offer his son the satisfying summer camp experience that eluded him as a child, the operator of a neighborhood day care center opens his own camp, only to face financial hardship and stiff competition from a rival camp.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.0 · 2019 · Grand-Daddy Day Care
metas.description: A family man turns his house into a 'day care' center for senior citizens.
